svg.title: Nengnanum Beauty — heritage and atelier story redesign
svg.desc: Editable SVG redesign preserving the dark-luxury heritage concept with an editorial navy and ivory rhythm, restrained gold accents, simpler sections, and original reference photography.
svg.text: Born from the clandestine threshold where ancient Damascene rose
hydro-distillation meets Swiss colloidal biochemistry. A quiet
tribute to nocturnal botanicals, patient craft, and luminous skin.
Three principles guide every formulation: patient harvesting, inherited craft,
Hand-harvested Damascene rose, gathered at first light wh
en its aromatic profile is most delicate.

Micro-colloidal gold and measured maturation, refined wit
h restraint for a luminous finish.
Four million hand-gathered petals yield each litre of our
signature rose essence. We favor patient gravity-led separation
over industrial speed, protecting the character of every harvest.
but in the patience of extraction.
If an oil requires three moons to
settle into harmony, we grant it four.”
Mireille Al-Mansoor leads the atelier with a belief in slow craft,
botanical precision, and formulas made with intention. Her work
bridges Damascene heritage and modern cosmetic science.
MASTER NOSE & CO-FOUNDER · PARIS · DAMASCUS · GENEVA

Why is the harvest limited to predawn hours?
Cooler air helps preserve the delicate aromatic profile of the rose petals.
